commands.description: Creates a copy of an existing model with a new name. Useful as a starting point before customising it with a Modelfile.
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace model names before running.

commands.title: Create a custom AI model (Modelfile)
commands.description: Creates a Modelfile — the recipe for building a custom Ollama model. FROM sets the base model. SYSTEM sets a permanent system prompt (its personality/role). PARAMETER sets model behaviour. Save this to a file called 'Modelfile' then run: ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile
commands.command:
cat > Modelfile << 'EOF'
FROM llama3
SYSTEM "You are a helpful Linux expert. Be concise and practical."
PARAMETER temperature 0.7
PARAMETER num_ctx 4096
EOF
commands.shell_only_reason: Edit the SYSTEM prompt to set your AI's personality, then run in terminal.

commands.title: Build model from Modelfile
commands.description: Builds and registers a custom Ollama model from a Modelfile in the current directory. Replace 'mymodel' with whatever name you want. After this you can run: ollama run mymodel
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace 'mymodel' with your chosen model name.

commands.title: Import a GGUF model file into Ollama
commands.description: Creates an Ollama model from a local .gguf file downloaded from Hugging Face or elsewhere. Replace the path with your actual .gguf file path.
commands.command:
cat > Modelfile << 'EOF'
FROM ./model.gguf
EOF
ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace ./model.gguf with your file path and edit before running.

commands.title: Call Ollama API (chat)
commands.description: Sends a message to the Ollama REST API and streams the response. The API is always available at localhost:11434 while Ollama is running. You can integrate this into scripts or apps.

commands.title: Call Ollama API (generate / completion)
commands.description: Uses the generate endpoint for a single completion (no chat history). Add 'stream: false' to get the whole response at once instead of streaming tokens.

commands.title: Generate text embeddings via Ollama API
commands.description: Generates a vector embedding for a text string. Embeddings let you measure semantic similarity between texts — the foundation of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.

commands.title: List models via Ollama API
commands.description: Calls the Ollama REST API to list all locally installed models. Useful for integrating model selection into your own apps.

commands.title: Monitor GPU usage (NVIDIA)
commands.description: Shows live GPU stats for NVIDIA cards: memory used/total, GPU utilisation %, temperature, and running processes. Essential when running large AI models to see if they fit in VRAM.

commands.title: Watch GPU usage live (NVIDIA)
commands.description: Refreshes nvidia-smi every second so you can watch VRAM and GPU load change in real time as a model loads or runs inference.

commands.title: Monitor GPU usage (AMD)
commands.description: Shows GPU stats for AMD cards using ROCm. Displays VRAM usage, GPU load and temperature. Required for running Ollama with AMD GPU acceleration.

commands.title: Check if GPU is available for AI
commands.description: Checks whether your system has a CUDA (NVIDIA) or ROCm (AMD) capable GPU available, and whether the drivers are working. Ollama will use GPU automatically if detected.
commands.command: python3 -c "import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi'],capture_output=True); print('NVIDIA GPU found' if r.returncode==0 else 'No NVIDIA GPU')"

commands.title: Install Ollama Python library
commands.description: Installs the official Ollama Python client. Lets you call Ollama models from Python scripts with a clean API: import ollama; ollama.chat(model='llama3', messages=[...])

commands.title: Install Hugging Face Transformers
commands.description: Installs the Hugging Face Transformers library — the most popular Python library for working with AI models. Gives you access to thousands of models for text, image, audio and more.

commands.title: Install PyTorch (CPU)
commands.description: Installs PyTorch — the leading deep learning framework. This installs the CPU-only version. For GPU support visit pytorch.org to get the right CUDA command for your GPU.
commands.command: pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

commands.title: Install LangChain (AI app framework)
commands.description: Installs LangChain — a framework for building AI-powered applications with chains, agents, RAG pipelines, and tool use. Works with Ollama and most LLM providers.

commands.title: Install OpenAI Python client
commands.description: Installs the OpenAI Python library. Also works with any OpenAI-compatible API including Ollama (set base_url='http://localhost:11434/v1') and many other local model servers.

commands.title: Install Whisper (speech to text)
commands.description: Installs OpenAI Whisper — a state-of-the-art speech recognition model that runs locally. Transcribes audio files to text in many languages.

commands.title: Download a model from Hugging Face
commands.description: Downloads a model from the Hugging Face Hub using the huggingface_hub library. Models are cached in ~/.cache/huggingface/. Replace the repo_id with any model on huggingface.co.
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace the model ID with the one you want from huggingface.co

commands.title: Log in to Hugging Face
commands.description: Authenticates with Hugging Face Hub using your API token. Required to download gated models like Llama 3 (need to request access on the model page first).
commands.shell_only_reason: Interactive login — run in your terminal with your HF token ready.

commands.title: Show Hugging Face model cache
commands.description: Lists all models cached locally by the Hugging Face library, with their disk usage. Cache lives in ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/

commands.title: Transcribe audio file to text (Whisper)
commands.description: Uses OpenAI Whisper to transcribe an audio file to text locally, no internet needed. Replace audio.mp3 with your file. Model sizes: tiny, base, small, medium, large (more accurate but slower).
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace audio.mp3 with your audio file path.

commands.title: Use Ollama with OpenAI-compatible API
commands.description: Ollama exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1. This lets you use any OpenAI client library (Python, JavaScript, etc.) pointing to your local Ollama instead of the cloud. Great for privacy.

commands.title: Send an image to a vision model
commands.description: Sends an image to a multimodal model (like LLaVA) via the Ollama API. The image must be base64-encoded. Replace the path with your image file.
commands.command: ollama run llava "What is in this image?" --images ./photo.jpg
commands.shell_only_reason: Replace ./photo.jpg with your image path. Run in terminal.
